skills.summary: Deterministic gate that rejects guaranteed search rankings or AI-answer placement, uncited ranking outcomes and statistics, and fabricated or unverifiable citations, quotes and numbers in a draft.
triggers: Claims check before staging marketing, SEO/AIO or communications copy
Fact-check this draft against the sources register
boundaries: Does not judge tone, brand fit, legal compliance or truth
Does not fetch pages; a human verifies the register
inputs: Sources register JSON with verbatim excerpts, an author and a sign-off by a different named human bound to the sources hash
prerequisites: company-fleets and factory-rig beside this skill: the register's sign-off is read from the owner log
method: Read its sign-off from the owner log by the sources hash
Normalize the text a reader sees (entities, NFKC, invisible and look-alike characters) and split it into sentences, fenced and footnote text included
skills.output_contract: One JSON object: ok, findings (rule, blocking, line, excerpt, message), checked counts and limits.
failure_states: Invalid register or an unclosed code fence: exit 2
No owner-log sign-off for the exact sources: register-not-signed-off
A negation cue after the phrase: blocks, reword

skills.summary: Send gate for staged email: suppression enforced at staging and at send, approval bound to campaign and recipient hashes by a named human, and a local fake outbox as the only transport.
triggers: Suppression or unsubscribe check before any email
inputs: Suppression list and send approval, from the campaign's owner log (company-fleets fleets/corporate/owner/<campaign_id>)
prerequisites: company-fleets and factory-rig beside this skill: the suppression list and the approval are read from the owner log
method: Stage recipients and hashes against the pinned suppression list
A human approves the hashes; the contract owner records it with fleet owner-record --kind send-approval
Send re-reads the pinned suppression list and writes to the fake outbox
stopping_conditions: Send exit 0 with messages in the outbox
Send exit 1 refused with the outbox untouched
skills.output_contract: One JSON object; stage prints the staged record, send prints ok, sent, already_sent, suppressed_at_send, refused, transport and limits.
failure_states: No approval in the owner log, wrong hash, edited staged file, a non-fake channel, or no owner ledger or suppression pin for the campaign: refused
